title: Increasing Tangential Gain for Improved Maneuverability
statement: Increasing the tangential gain will allow the robot to better navigate around obstacles, reducing the risk of collisions.
mechanism: The tangential gain controls the robot's ability to adjust its path to avoid obstacles while moving forward.
